items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. Where were you born, Mr. Stack?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, on the 22nd of November, 1877. Yes. Understand?
Yes. Where were you born, Mr. Stack?
Right here in New Orleans, downtown, though, in the Ninth Ward. Ah. Does this record what I said?
